paper.title: Physiological levels of 3-hydroxykynurenine alter mitochondrial function and morphology in neuronal cells
paper.caption: Transcriptomic profiling and differential gene expression analysis revealed altered expression of mitochondrially relevant genes following treatment with 3-HK. (A) DESeq2 results table showing the number of significantly up/down regulated differentially expressed transcripts in each experimental condition. VEH = vehicle control. (B) Normalised read counts of transcript NM_001278463 encoding for gene DNM1L when treated with 3-HK compared between conditions. (C) Normalised read counts of transcript NM_002693 encoding for gene POLG when treated with 3-HK compared between conditions. (D) Normalised read counts of transcript NM_012237 encoding for gene SIRT2 when treated with 3-HK compared between conditions. (E) Normalised read counts of transcript NM_001003788 encoding for gene STRADA when treated with 3-HK compared between conditions. Each point represents one biological replicate. Interquartile range shown per condition. ***P < 0.001. **P < 0.01. *P < 0.05.
